overview_description.description: camelAI is a secure platform for vibe coding real software. Today, vibe coders are building with AI tools that put API keys, customer records, and regulated data in places IT can't see. Companies use camelAI to give these domain experts a safe place to build internal tools, dashboards, and automations. Every app is full stack by default, with a real backend and a database. camelAI works with every major LLM: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, and more. It plugs into the AI accounts you already have and can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure.
